model.name: unitStore.assertSinglePhysicalStore
model.description: Assert ONE physical unit store: exactly one tree holds real *.scenario.json (scenario/index); every other index tree is symlink-only; no uuid has a 2nd real file anywhere (fail-closed + name-both on divergence).
